_comment: Official repositories, cloned by setup_third_party.sh into <third_party>/<dir> and checked out at the pinned commit. Code is imported from these clones; nothing is vendored.

SwinIR.note: models/network_swinir.py is byte-identical in every commit from 9d14daa8 to 6545850f (7 commits). Network arguments follow main_test_swinir.py define_model (classical_sr / lightweight_sr, training_patch_size 64).

HAT.note: HAT imports the pip package basicsr (registry + arch_util.to_2tuple/trunc_normal_ only). methods.py provides these two names from timm instead of installing basicsr; they are only used at construction/initialisation and the official weights overwrite every parameter.

IET.cuda_extension: ops_smm (smm_cuda, different source from PFT-SR), built by build_smm.py; also needs NATTEN
IET.note: Upstream HEAD has moved past this commit; the pinned commit is the one the benchmark was verified on.

NATTEN.note: Built from source against the local torch (CUDA arch from NATTEN_CUDA_ARCH). The patch replaces `from torch.cuda import _device_t` (removed in recent torch) with `from torch.types import Device as _device_t` in four files; no kernel code is changed.
